rollforward.distribution_paid_declared_verbatim: For the financial year ended 31 December 2024, Keppel REIT has distributed 100% of its taxable income available for distribution to Unitholders (p110 marker); FY2024 DPU 5.60 cents (2.80c 1H + 2.80c 2H). Declared-for-year distribution on DPU basis = for-year distributable income 214,547 (=B under 100% payout, no retention). DISTINCT from in-year cash paid P=216,608 which mixes 2H2023 + 1H2024 tranches.
rollforward.notes: Audited Distribution Statement, FY ended 31 Dec 2024, GROUP column, <!-- PAGE 117 --> marker (printed folio 122). Values in full SGD (statement in $'000). A=109,932; B (for-year subtotal, BEFORE folding opening carry)=214,547; P (Total Unitholders' distribution incl capital gains, Note B)=216,608; E=107,871. Guard A+B-P = 109,932+214,547-216,608 = 107,871 = E exactly (tol 1000, PASS). TRAP AVOIDED: the cumulative line 'Income available for distribution to Unitholders' 324,479 folds in opening 109,932 (109,932+214,547=324,479) and was NOT used as B. distribution_paid_declared (DPU-basis 5.60c, =B under 100% payout) recorded and flagged as derived from the 100%-payout statement + DPU; not a distinct explicit line in the Distribution Statement. Note B breakdown of P: Taxable income (114,403) + Tax exempt income (82,443) + Capital gains (19,762) = 216,608 (incl 20,000 Anniversary/capital-gains distribution).
